limitations: Repository-only. Auto-merge OFF; NOT merged, NOT deployed. The verifier-window-open authorization CONTRACT is built and tested but NOT wired to the real verifier window / INGEST event path: the current INGEST feed is still authenticated by a symmetric HMAC window key, so the full no-symmetric-secret end state additionally needs an INGEST event-signing asymmetric migration (host-private signs events / backend-public verifies). Until then the production opener stays unprovisioned (verifier_window_opener=None).
The replay nonce store default is in-memory (single process); a production opener needs a DURABLE single-use store (DB/cache).

The #48 admission reader (a reviewed signed read-only host interface returning identity/flatness/admission-off + observed_at) is NOT built here; production_follower_reader returns EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE (fail closed).
Pinning a real COPIER_WINDOW_OPEN_TRUST public key, enabling the execution flag + host executor, and the live #46->#48 demonstration each remain separate, Sponsor-gated steps.
Ed25519 verification uses the backend `cryptography` library (importable in the backend lane); the TIM stdlib verify-only module is untouched and un-imported, preserving identity separation.
